summary: Successfully implemented KAFKA-20282: Added a log recommendation in ClassicKafkaConsumer that informs users about the production-ready new Consumer rebalance protocol (KIP-848) when they start a consumer with the classic protocol and a group ID configured. The implementation adds a conditional log.info() message at the start of the ClassicKafkaConsumer constructor that checks if a group ID is present. All four related test cases pass: testClassicProtocolLogsRecommendationToTryConsumerProtocol, testConsumerProtocolDoesNotLogRecommendation, testDefaultProtocolLogsRecommendationToTryConsumerProtocol, and testNoGroupIdDoesNotLogGroupProtocolMessage.
